TeamLead.description: Team lead: unpacks features into phases, epics and stories; refines each story into a detailed technical plan before development and fixes it in place. Does not review code or merge.

Developer.description: Developer: implements one approved story at a time, with tests.

QA.description: QA: checks a story's implementation against its acceptance criteria and the test results, and reports bugs precisely.

Reviewer.description: Reviewer: reviews the code of a ticket after QA, read-only, against the ticket's plan and acceptance criteria, and passes or fails it with precise findings. Never edits files or runs the tests.

ProductOwner.description: Product owner: unpacks features into planning files and a ticket manifest.
